title: Emission count and output length
statement: Let $M$ be a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be a binary input, let $d$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The output length of $d$ plus the number of true entries in the emission mask for the first $t$ steps from $d$ equals the output length of the configuration reached after $t$ steps of $M$ from $d$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite deterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
replaced: Let $M$ be a deterministic machine, $d$ a configuration and $t$ a step count. The output length of $d$ plus the number of $1$ entries in the emission mask over $t$ steps equals the output length of the configuration reached after $t$ steps of $M$ from $d$.
